rci1_using_msad.detail: Study 2 HC reference cohort is multi-site (3 HCP-EP sites); Study 1 HC reference cohort is single-site (UCSF).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Study 1 included healthy control participants (HCs), participants at CHR-P, and participants with early-illness schizophrenia (ESZ) who underwent MRI scanning at the University of California San Francisco." "HC, non-affective psychosis (NAff-P), and affective psychosis (Aff-P) individuals were scanned at one of three sites (Indiana University [ n =80], Brigham and Women's Hospital [ n =46], and McLean Hospital [ n =43]) as part of the Human Connectome Project-Early Psychosis (HCPEP) study."
rci1_using_msad.location: study_1/Hua2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study 1 Participants; study_1/1-s2.0-S2451902224001599-mmc1.pdf.md: Supplemental Methods / Participants
